colleges.meta: Chapel Hill, NC · Public · Vybhav's target
colleges.name: UNC Chapel Hill
colleges.note: The goal: a top public university with a strong pre-med track and the UNC School of Medicine on the same campus. Strong in biology, chemistry and health sciences; check Early Action deadlines in the fall of senior year.

colleges.name: Duke University
colleges.note: Elite research university with Duke University School of Medicine and hospital next door - exceptional pre-med advising, research and clinical volunteering access.

colleges.name: NC State University
colleges.note: Strong and affordable STEM powerhouse minutes from home; solid pre-health advising and a popular backup-or-parallel path for life-sciences majors.

colleges.name: Wake Forest University
colleges.note: Small classes, strong pre-med placement, and the Wake Forest School of Medicine nearby for shadowing and research.

colleges.name: Davidson College
colleges.note: A top liberal-arts college famous for pre-med preparation - close faculty mentorship and a strong record of medical-school acceptances.

colleges.name: East Carolina University
colleges.note: Home to the Brody School of Medicine, which prioritizes North Carolina residents - a strategic in-state angle for med school itself.

colleges.name: UNC Charlotte
colleges.note: Fast-growing research university with solid biology and health programs and a lower cost profile than the privates.

colleges.name: Elon University
colleges.note: Known for engaged learning and strong health-professions advising; a good private-university alternative in-state.

intro: A running guide to North Carolina colleges for Vybhav - strong pre-med options, plus the latest campus news refreshed hourly below.
